name: theme-evolution-os2
description: Build tooling for the theme-evolution-os2 Shopify theme (Tailwind CSS). See docs/plans/theme-evolution-tailwind.md.

scripts.check:css: npm run build:css && node scripts/check-css-layers.mjs && git ls-files --error-unmatch assets/tailwind.css && git diff --exit-code -- assets/tailwind.css
scripts.check: npm run check:css && npm run check:hidden && shopify theme check
